risks: On load it deletes and rewrites its own folder inside ComfyUI's web/extensions, so it should not go straight into a shared install.
nodes/acestep/patches.py replaces one ComfyUI helper, reshape_mask, for everyone in that process.
Its Open-Unmix node runs torch.hub.load, which downloads and runs code and weights from GitHub the first time. That node wasn't run for this page.
The extend and repaint guiders download silence_latent.pt from ACE-Step's Hugging Face page the first time, loaded with weights_only=True.

film.title: Wren Halloway, “Light the Wreckage”
film.label: Made before this studio
film.pitch: A whole song, filmed. Wren Halloway is a singer we invented: an original song with our own lyrics, sung by Music 3, then 28 lip-synced shots of her made with LTX-2.5 with the song locked into the video's audio.

credits.model: MiniMax Music 3, seed 9140, 175 s, mastered to -14 LUFS
LTX-2.5 distilled, two-stage image to video, 1344x768, with the song locked into its audio

credits.part: Stills of Wren and the four sets
credits.model: CyberRealistic Flux v2.5, a FLUX.1 dev fine-tune

honest: Made on 2026-10-06 on this machine with our earlier scripts, before this studio existed. No page or graph in the studio made it.
A first cut: the first take of all 28 shots. Retakes of the 13 shots that failed our lip-sync check stopped after 7, so in some shots her mouth drifts from the words.
Checked by machine: Whisper (distil-large-v3) made out 240 of the 260 lyric words in the finished mix, so the vocals are clear words, not garble.
Wren is invented. We checked every shot for real people, brands and broken lettering; the only words on screen are the title and end cards. The crowd in the club is generated too.
This copy is scaled down to 720p (18 MiB) from the 1080p cut.

brief.title: Paper Boats
brief.style: Warm adult contemporary pop ballad, soft female lead vocal, felt piano, brushed drums, round electric bass, gentle string pad, 72 BPM, G major, nostalgic and hopeful, clean modern mix
brief.instrumental: Warm adult contemporary pop ballad, instrumental, felt piano melody, brushed drums, round electric bass, gentle string pad, 72 BPM, G major, nostalgic and hopeful, clean modern mix
brief.caption:
Global Metadata: Adult contemporary pop ballad. 72 BPM, G major. Nostalgic and hopeful, a quiet morning feeling that opens up gently in each chorus. Clean modern mix, warm and close, no heavy effects.

Vocal Details: Soft female lead vocal, clear diction, close to the microphone, gentle vibrato on long notes, light harmony on the chorus. Every lyric line sung plainly and in order.

Arrangement: Felt piano carries the harmony from the first bar. Brushed drums and round electric bass enter in the first chorus and stay. A gentle string pad swells under the choruses and thins out for the second verse. A short piano phrase closes the song.
